responsibility: This file provides the helper that lets GCC run the backend RTL pipeline directly starting from an existing RTL function body, typically for front-end or selftest-driven workflows. It sets up the function’s starting pass name, initializes section/debug and scheduling state when beginning mid-pipeline, executes the rest_of_compilation and clean_state pass lists from the pass manager, and finalizes RTL properties and bitmap obstacks. Its role is direct orchestration of a subset of the RTL pipeline outside the normal expand-driven flow.
same_name_distinction: Implements the helper that actually starts and executes the RTL pass pipeline from a chosen pass name, including setup and cleanup of backend state; run-rtl-passes.h just declares that entry point.
